This means that the pMOST pairs goes off exactly at the point where the nMOST pair comes up. This cross-over point is exactly at halfway the supply voltage for the average input. Also, this point is exactly where the g ’s are halved. As a result, m there is no more sum to be taken, except around the middle of the input range.
